senses.gloss: to go around; to turn; with ל to turn to, follow; with מן, מ־, to turn away; in gen. [to turn from the right path,] to go astray; to degenerate.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 21b:16">Snh. 21ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:17">Deut. XVII, 17</cite>) <he>אני ארבה ולא אָסוּר</he> I (Solomon) will take many wives and yet not go astray.

<cite ref="Berakhot 19b">Ber. 19ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לאו דלא תָסוּר</he> the prohibition inplied in the words, ‘thou shalt not deviate’ (from the decisions of the courts, the interpretations of the Rabbis, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:11">Deut. XVII, 11</cite>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:41">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:7">Am. VI, 7</cite>) <he>אותה שעה תָסוּר שמחת הסרוחים</he> at that time shall the joy of the (corrupt) banqueters cease; a. e.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:9">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (play on <cite ref="O00827"><he>סיר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 60:10">Ps. LX, 10</cite>) <he>והֵסַרְתִּי הצרעת מעליו</he> and I removed the leprosy from him; <he>שהסרתי אותו מן הטביעה</he> whom I removed (saved) from drowning, v. <cite ref="I00056"><he>טְבִיעָה</he> I</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:1">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>הָסֵר הטומאה וכ׳</he> remove the uncleanness out of thy house; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 2:4">Snh. II, 4</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:17">Deut. XVII, 17</cite>) <he>ובלבד שלא יהו מְסִירוֹת את לבו</he> provided they (the wives) do not corrupt his heart; <he>אפי׳ אחת ומְסִירָה וכ׳</he> even one wife, if she might corrupt his heart, he must not marry.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 68b:6">Kidd. 68ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:4">Deut. VII, 4</cite>) <he>לרבות כל המְסִירִים</he> this is to intimate the extension of the prohibition of intermarriage to all nations that might lead astray; <cite ref="Yevamot 23a">Yeb. 23ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 36b:6">Ab. Zar. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>המְסִירוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Makkot 5a:9">Macc. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="O01542"><he>סרה</he></cite> <cite ref="Deuteronomy 19:16">Deut. XIX, 16</cite>) <he>עד שתּוּסַר גופה של עדות</he> Ar. s. v. <he>זמם</he> (ed. <he>שתסרה</he>) until the testimony itself has been removed (an alibi has been proved).
